topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 120 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 17 ERC20 tokens, 27 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 37 common project-authored base contract(s) (depositvault, manageablevault, blacklistable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
